function.name: start_new_intake
function.description: Creates a new job from a voice call. Use ONLY after you've confirmed: first name, phone, zip, appliance type, and a brief problem description. The office will follow up by text within minutes with scheduling options. Sets channel='voice' for audit trail.

first_name.description: Caller's first name. Ask if not yet known.

last_name.description: Caller's last name. Optional but ideal — ask if natural.

phone.description: Callback phone. Use caller ID if confirmed, otherwise ask + verify digit by digit.

zip.description: 5-digit US zip code where the appliance is located. Run check_service_zone first if you haven't already.

appliance_type.description: washer / dryer / dishwasher / refrigerator / range / oven / microwave / hvac / other

brand.description: Appliance brand if the caller mentioned it (e.g., Whirlpool, LG, GE).

problem_summary.description: Brief plain-English description of the problem (e.g., 'fridge not cooling', 'dryer making loud noise', 'dishwasher leaking').

customer_type.description: Always pass 'self_pay' for inbound calls unless the caller explicitly says they have a warranty (AHS, ServicePower, Frontdoor, SquareTrade, Allstate).
